description: Using recent missions and discoveries, Brian revisits the solar system through volcanic worlds, dark outer regions, extreme weather, exotic ice and the strange objects that resist simple classification.

s05e01.description: Brian explores planets and moons shaped by violent volcanoes, including eruptions of both fire and ice that can reach far into space.

s05e02.description: Brian explores the hidden regions between and beyond the planets, where countless small and distant worlds remain in darkness.

s05e03.description: Brian investigates the solar system’s most extreme weather, from immense lightning to metallic frost and methane monsoons.

s05e04.description: Brian journeys through ice giants and frozen moons where familiar water ice gives way to exotic forms and unexpected geological activity.

s05e05.description: Brian explores the solar system’s oddballs and misfits and the forces that created their most bizarre shapes, orbits and surfaces.
